title: Desktop Application & Architecture Overhaul
description: Launching the official Pegasus Desktop app alongside a massive architectural migration to Pinia and a more robust authentication system.
highlights: Migration to Pinia for State Management

items.title: Official Desktop Launch
items.description: Pegasus is now available as a standalone desktop application.
details: Native macOS and Windows builds available
Optimized resource management for desktop environments
Direct database connection support within the desktop wrapper

items.title: WorkOS Authentication
items.description: Enterprise-ready authentication for improved security and session management.
details: Secure login, logout, and session handling

items.title: Isolated Chat History
items.description: Each spreadsheet or query tab now maintains its own independent chat session.
details: Context window is now specific to the active tab
Switching tabs preserves the conversation state for that specific dataset

items.title: Architecture Overhaul (Pinia)
items.description: Migrated from standard reactive state to Pinia for better performance and debugging.
details: Reduced reactive loops and improved UI responsiveness

items.title: Modular Backend Routing
items.description: Refactored backend into modular service files for faster feature development.
details: Dedicated routes for Dashboards, Connections, and Tables
Clean service-layer separation for database operations

items.title: Stability & Reliability
items.description: Addressed several core issues following the beta period.
details: Fixed navigation loops in Workspace watcher
Resolved recursive updates in connection store
Improved CORS handling for production environments
Fixed Delete key behavior for clearing spreadsheet selections
